series.title: Bank Failures 1934-2026
series.description: Every FDIC-insured bank failure on record: failing institution, failure date, estimated loss to the Deposit Insurance Fund, and total assets where reported. 4,115 failure events.

source.name: FDIC BankFind Suite API - failures endpoint

construction.method: Full API pull (paginated JSON), flattened to one row per failure event.

series.units: failure events; estimated loss and total assets in USD

quality.notes: Includes the 2023 failure wave (SVB, Signature, First Republic).

series.title: FDIC SDI Financials 1984-2026

source.name: FDIC BankFind Suite API - financials endpoint (Statistics on Depository Institutions)

construction.method: 168 paginated JSON pages concatenated, loaded via DuckDB JSON reader, SQL-unpivoted wide-to-long.

series.units: USD in SDI reporting units (see FDIC SDI codebook per variable)

quality.notes: Long format: one row per (institution, quarter, variable).

series.title: FDIC Institution History 1782-2026

series.title: FDIC Summary of Deposits 1994-2025

series.title: SDI-Derived Bank Feature Panel 1984-2025

construction.method: Deterministic SQL feature build over fdic_financials.

quality.notes: Derived table - the public API is the upstream source.

series.title: Consolidated Call Reports 1976-2026
series.description: The unified Call Report long table: 1.92 billion (institution, quarter, MDRM item) observations across 50 years, harmonized from three vintages: Chicago Fed Commercial Bank Data (1976-2002), FFIEC CDR public bulk (2012+), and gap-fill from CDR. This single table carries the modern regulatory balance-sheet and income-statement core of the warehouse.

source.name: FFIEC Central Data Repository (public bulk) + Chicago Fed Commercial Bank Data (historical vintage)

construction.method: Three-track ingest: SAS XPT files 1976-2002 (146 quarterly files, wide-to-long over 2,800+ variable columns); FFIEC CDR bulk ZIPs 2012+ via the bulk download flow; CDR gap-fill for missing quarters. All tracks unpivot to (rssd, period_end, mdrm_item, value).

series.units: varies by MDRM item (USD thousands for $ items, counts, ratios - see MDRM definitions)

quality.notes: The 1976-2002 XPT vintage is the Chicago Fed Commercial Bank Data product, distributed under its own license (institutional/subscription distribution); public keyless coverage starts 2001+ at FFIEC CDR. See D03 for the honest reproduction ladder.

construction.method: Per-quarter tab-delimited ZIPs acquired from the CDR bulk download flow and ingested long.

series.title: UBPR Peer Group Statistics 2002-2026

series.title: FRED Banking Series (H.8 + macro context) 1954-2026
series.description: Federal Reserve H.8 aggregate banking series (bank credit, loans, securities, deposits), key rates, and macro context (GDP, unemployment, CPI, industrial production): 1.35M observations. The 15 aggregate series are keyless; the full disaggregated H.8 release (~1,938 series by bank size/type) requires a free FRED API key.

source.name: FRED (St. Louis Fed) - fredgraph.csv (keyless) + FRED API release 22 (full H.8)

construction.method: Keyless CSV download per series for the 15 aggregates; API-paged JSON for the full H.8 release; both appended to one long table.

series.units: varies by series (USD billions, percent, index) - series_id keys to FRED

quality.notes: Full H.8 layer needs FRED_API_KEY (free). Frequency varies by series; per-series metadata lives in the table itself.
